description.value: The Telkwa Reading Centre is a volunteer-staffed community library nestled beside the spectacular Bulkley River in the historic Village of Telkwa. The centre offers books, programs, and events for all ages, and its riverside setting makes it one of the more scenic library stops in northern BC. It serves as a cultural waypoint on Highway 16 between Smithers and Prince George.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a volunteer-run reading centre beside the Bulkley River at 5500 Madison Avenue — but OSM names it 'Reading Room' (website says 'Reading Centre') and gives housenumber 5000 (website says 5500). The website provides no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields are null. The site does confirm the reading centre is operational and describes its location and programming.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM says 'Reading Room' but website consistently calls it 'Reading Centre' or 'Telkwa Reading Centre'.
Address mismatch: OSM housenumber is 5000 but website states 5500 Madison Avenue — address used here is from website.
OSM address is incomplete (housenumber only, no street name).
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) could be confirmed from website content.
Phone number sourced from website only; OSM has no phone on record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue is a real, operational community reading centre with scenic riverside appeal, but no cycling-specific amenities are confirmed, the OSM name and address both differ from the website, and the very limited volunteer hours mean utility to touring cyclists is uncertain.
enrichment_extras.notes: The same webpage also describes the nearby Telkwa Museum at 1620 Highway 16 (phone 250-846-9656), which is a separate OSM candidate and should not be merged with this record.

wow_evidence: Volunteer library beside the Bulkley River; ordinary library band, lovely setting.
blurb: Volunteer-run reading centre beside the Bulkley River in Telkwa.
